name: @red-cup-engineering/feltos-perception-frame-service
description: The agent-legible perception frame every feltos/qwzspace text game hands qwzspace as an entity's render state, declared once through computer-system-engine's type system: shared cell/subject/event/clock types, a per-game frame-type factory, buildPerceptionFrame/perceptionSnapEntry (the one perceive-settle-assemble-admit algorithm every such frame is built by), and the displayName/exitsOf world readers it's built from.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run test
